user.title: Add an ESP-Weaver device
user.description: To update a custom product, upload its product profile here.

data.overwrite: Replace an existing file with the same name
data.repository_source: Read the repository from a pull request

data_description.overwrite: Enable only when you intend to replace a custom profile with the same filename.
data_description.repository_source: Leave empty to use the published repository. Enter a pull request number or URL to use the products generated for its latest commit. The selection remains active until this field is cleared.

connection_mode.title: Select connection
connection_mode.description:
Choose how you want ESP-Weaver to connect to your device.

• **Local control**: Find devices connected to the same network as Home Assistant
• **Cloud control**: Connect through ESP RainMaker

rainmaker_login.title: Sign in to RainMaker
rainmaker_login.description: Sign in to your ESP RainMaker account to view and add its devices.

data_description.rainmaker_region: The RainMaker region where the devices are registered.

cloud_action_select.title: Choose an action
cloud_action_select.description: Choose whether to add a device already in your account or set up a new device over Bluetooth.

ble_scan.title: Enter provisioning service name
ble_scan.description: Power on your device, then enter the provisioning service name shown in its serial log, for example `PROV_724d86`.

wifi_config.title: Configure Wi-Fi
wifi_config.description: Enter the Wi-Fi details that **{device_name}** should use.

data_description.device_pop: The PoP provided with the device, if required.

provisioning_failed.title: Device setup did not finish
provisioning_failed.description:
The device could not be added: {error}

Try again, or go back to check the Wi-Fi settings.

cloud_device_select.title: Select cloud device
cloud_device_select.description:
Devices available in your ESP RainMaker account: {device_count}

Select the device you want to add.

pop_input.title: Enter Proof of Possession (PoP)
pop_input.description: You can find the PoP on the device's **Node Info** page in the ESP RainMaker app. Enter it here.

profile_select.title: Select {vendor} product
profile_select.description: Select the product that matches your device. Type a name or model to filter the list.

device_mismatch.title: Product does not match
device_mismatch.description:
Selected product: **{product}**

Device model: **{reported_model}**

{reason}

The device has not been added. Select **Submit** to choose another product while keeping the device connected, or close the dialog to cancel.

progress.provisioning: Setting up **{device_name}**… Wi-Fi credentials are being sent over Bluetooth. This can take a few minutes.

error.invalid_pop: The PoP is invalid. Check it and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the device. Make sure it is powered on and connected to the same network as Home Assistant.
error.invalid_device_selection: Select a device from the list.
error.rainmaker_login_failed: Could not sign in to RainMaker. Check your credentials.
error.provisioning_failed: Could not set up the device. Make sure it is in provisioning mode and try again.
error.wifi_password_required: Wi-Fi password is required. Open networks are not supported.
error.profile_import_failed: The profile was not imported, so nothing was saved: {error}
error.import_bad_filename: `{filename}` is not a valid profile filename. Use a filename ending in .yaml or .yml, without a directory path.
error.import_exists: `{filename}` already exists. Turn on "Replace an existing file with the same name" to replace it.
error.import_write_failed: Could not write `{filename}` to the profile directory: {error}
error.upload_expired: The upload is no longer available. Please choose the file again.
error.upload_invalid: The profile `{filename}` failed validation, so nothing was saved: {detail}
error.upload_not_text: The selected file is not UTF-8 text. Save it as UTF-8 and choose it again.
error.upload_too_large: `{filename}` exceeds the {limit} KB profile size limit. Check that you selected the correct file.
error.upload_unreadable: Could not read the file you chose: {error}
error.profile_unknown: Select a product from the list. Typing only filters the list.
error.profile_fetch_failed: The selected product could not be loaded. Check the network connection or select another product.
error.vendor_unknown: Select a manufacturer from the list. Typing only filters the list.
error.provisioning_not_in_cloud: The device connected to Wi-Fi but has not appeared in your ESP RainMaker account yet. Wait a moment and try again.
error.provisioning_ambiguous: Several devices joined your account during setup ({error}), so the new device could not be identified. No device was added. Select it from the cloud device list instead.
error.repository_source_invalid: Enter a pull request number such as `123`, or the URL of its GitHub page.
error.repository_source_unreachable: `{source}` could not be read from GitHub: {error}

abort.no_devices_found: No devices were found. Make sure your device is powered on and connected to the same network as Home Assistant, then try again.
abort.security_unknown: **{device_name}** did not respond during connection setup, so it was not added. Wait for the device to finish starting and try again.
abort.node_unread: The device connected but did not provide the information needed to add it. Make sure the device is online and try again.
abort.no_new_devices_found: All discovered devices have already been added.
abort.no_fitting_devices: Devices found but not yet added: {found}. None match **{product}**. Check the selected product, then make sure your device is powered on and connected to the same network as Home Assistant.
abort.summary_failed: The selected product could not be used with this device, so the device was not added. Select another product and try again. If the problem continues, check the logs and report the issue.

init.title: Change product
init.description:
Current product: **{current}**

Select the manufacturer of the new product. Changing the product recreates its entities; entities that can be reused retain their history.{repository}

profile_select.title: Select {vendor} product
profile_select.description:
Current product: **{current}**

Select the new product. Type to filter; the source is shown only when needed.

device_mismatch.title: Product does not match
device_mismatch.description:
Selected product: **{product}**

Device model: **{reported_model}**

{reason}

The product was not changed. Select **Submit** to choose another product, or close the dialog to keep the current product.

error.profile_unknown: Select a product from the list. Typing only filters the list.
error.profile_fetch_failed: The selected product could not be loaded. Check the network connection or select another product.
error.vendor_unknown: Select a manufacturer from the list. Typing only filters the list.

abort.node_unread: The device has not provided the information needed to change its product. Make sure the device is online and try again.
abort.summary_failed: The selected product could not be used with this device, so nothing was changed. Select another product and try again. If the problem continues, check the logs and report the issue.

profile_invalid.title: Device profile {filename} is invalid
profile_invalid.description:
ESP-Weaver could not load the profile `{filename}` from `{directory}`, so it is excluded from the product list. Devices already using a stored copy are not affected.

Validation error:

```
{detail}
```

Correct the profile, then run the `esp_weaver.reload` action or reload the integration.

profile_misplaced.title: Device profile {filename} will be removed by an update
profile_misplaced.description:
The profile `{filename}` is stored in `{directory}`, which is replaced when ESP-Weaver is updated.

Move the profile to `{custom_dir}` in your Home Assistant configuration directory, then run the `esp_weaver.reload` action. Profiles in that directory are preserved during updates.

confirm.title: Update {product}
confirm.description:
Affected devices: {count}. Current and updated entity counts:

| Device | Current | Updated |
|---|---|---|
{rows}

Updating recreates the entities for all listed devices. Entities that can be reused retain their history. To update only one device, open its **Configure** dialog instead.

abort.profile_update_gone: The update changed or is no longer available. ESP-Weaver will notify you again if an update is still needed.
abort.profile_update_fetch_failed: The product update could not be downloaded. Check Home Assistant's network connection and try again later.

reload.name: Reload or import device profiles
reload.description: Reloads the local profile directory, online profile catalog, and all ESP-Weaver devices. To import a profile first, provide its URL. A profile that fails validation is not saved.

url.name: URL
url.description: URL of a profile YAML file. Leave empty to reload existing profiles. GitHub file-page and gist URLs are converted to raw URLs automatically.

filename.name: Filename
filename.description: Name to save the download as. Defaults to the filename in the URL.

overwrite.name: Overwrite
overwrite.description: Replace the file if it already exists.
